story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Always-visible period selector on voucher screens (header/toolbar), shows current period + 3 prior/next open periods (if available). 2. No create/post in closed/future period; API returns 400 with clear error message, attempt logged in audit. 3. On period close, batch-lock all vouchers in period (adds lock flag), creates audit event with: closed_by (user), closed_at (timestamp), hash_digest, close_reason. 4. Period reopen requires reason and approval metadata; all reopen attempts (even if not approved) logged in audit. 5. System automates required reversal of prior-period adjustments by creating offsetting entry in next open period (deferred to post-MVP, manual reversal in MVP). 6. Period summary dashboard badge displays: closing status, posting flow status, pending actions count (drafts in period).

constraints.constraint: All period management operations must enforce company scoping via CompanyScopeAspect and CompanyContext for multi-tenant data isolation." /> Period close/reopen operations require CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT, ADMIN, or CFO roles; period viewing requires ACCOUNTANT+ roles." /> Period close/reopen operations must use @Transactional for all-or-nothing execution across period status updates and voucher locking/unlocking." /> Follow VoucherValidationService patterns for comprehensive period validation with detailed error maps and aggregated error reporting." /> All period operations (close, reopen, validation failures) must be logged with JSON snapshots, SHA-256 hash digests, user metadata, and timestamps." /> Follow VoucherController patterns: /api/v1/periods endpoints with { data: AccountingPeriodDTO, meta: {...} } response format and proper HTTP status codes." /> Place PeriodSelector under components/period/ for shared use, period management pages under features/accounting/pages/Periods/." /> All period management components must use shadcn/ui components with consistent styling and accessibility features." /> Unit tests for service logic, integration tests for API endpoints, and negative tests for blocked operations following patterns from stories 3-3, 3-4, 3-5." /> Add appropriate indexes for period queries and audit log retrieval following V20251115001 migration patterns." />
